title: Selected Topics in Architectural Technology; EcoTech - Harnessing AI and ML for Sustainable Design
description: EcoTech explores the intersection of technology with sustainable architecture, emphasizing how AI and ML are revolutionizing green building designs. This course covers EcoTech's essentials within architecture, introducing various strategies and tech innovations for crafting eco-conscious, intelligent structures. Starting with AI and ML's basics and their roles in big data and predictive analytics, it explores their impact on advancing sustainable design. Students gain a comprehensive understanding through real-world examples, intensive workshops, and insights into industry-leading AI applications. The course aims to provide the insights and tools necessary for leading the creation of smart, sustainable buildings, highlighting a significant advancement in architectural innovation.
